entities.summary: Italian Renaissance artist (1475-1564) whose Sistine Chapel ceiling, David, and Pieta represent the highest achievements of Western visual art. As painter, sculptor, architect, and poet, Michelangelo embodied the Renaissance ideal of the universal genius and transformed the role of the artist from craftsman to creative visionary.
